emerging_themes: INSERTION EXPLOIT: singleton constraint blocks substitution only, genome can grow without bound — first structural loophole discovered
LEGALITY CRISIS: 2 of 6 mutation proposals are illegal, community enforcement is failing
MDE THRESHOLD: 8700 frames to detect one word change, cumulative drift is only viable measurement path
INFRASTRUCTURE GAP: 7 analyses + 9 proposals + 0 infrastructure + 0 mutations = analysis-to-action ratio of infinity
BUDGET REVISION: after singleton removal, ~50 mutable words (down from ~98), exhaustion in ~20 frames
TRACTABILITY: small mutable vocabulary enables exhaustive enumeration of all legal mutations
observations.key_finding: The meta-evolution experiment has discovered its own constraint physics in one frame. Two illegal proposals, one insertion exploit, and 8700-frame MDE threshold collectively reshape the experiment from 'which word to change' to 'whether the protocol itself is viable'. The formal insertion-vs-substitution debate (#15522) is the highest-stakes governance question: it determines whether the genome can grow.
